name: 01_coast_west
what: the W coast: the plateau, the shingle beach falling to the shore ice, the first sea cliffs

name: 02_wreck_beach
what: the wreck on the shore ice at the foot of the shingle beach (4.2 m below the plateau)

name: 03_cliffs_south
what: the S sea cliffs (6-8 m), talus at the foot, a rock stack in the shore-fast ice

name: 04_cave_stair
what: the sea cave, the shelf and the rock-cut stair to the clifftop (R-C9-206)

name: 05_cave_mouth
what: the cave mouth: an eroded arch, 7.3 m clear, receding into the rock (R-C9-206)

name: 06_mere_stream
what: the mere: one continuous ice sheet with thin cracks and pressure seams; the stream channel from the barrow

name: 07_pack_ice
what: the sea: broken pack -- plates of every size, rims, pressure ridges, brash, dark leads (~2/3 ice)

name: 08_start
what: the start in the broken stone ring (unchanged)

name: 09_stair_cave_close
what: close: the cave arch in its headland and the rock-cut stair across the face beside it (R-C9-208)
